original_comment: As a cancer survivor, I have personally and directly been affected by prior authorization. Due to prior authorization issues, I was initially billed over $20,000 for a surgery that I was assured would be in-network and covered by my insurance. This issue took months to be resolved and caused lots of unnecessary stress throughout chemotherapy. Halfway through treatment, I learned that my chemo was not approved due to prior authorization issues, and my treatment was delayed for weeks, causing additional stress and worry that my cancer would metastasize.

## 1. COMMENTER INFORMATION
